title: Computational Social Linguistics for Telugu Cultural Preservation: Novel Algorithms for Chandassu Metrical Pattern Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2510.01233v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This research presents a computational social science approach to preserving Telugu Chandassu, the metrical poetry tradition representing centuries of collective cultural intelligence. We develop the first comprehensive digital framework for analyzing Telugu prosodic patterns, bridging traditional community knowledge with modern computational methods. Our social computing approach involves collaborative dataset creation of 4,651 annotated padyams, validated linguistic patterns, and culturally informed algorithmic design. The framework includes AksharamTokenizer for prosody-aware tokenization, LaghuvuGuruvu Generator for classifying light and heavy syllables, and PadyaBhedam Checker for automated pattern recognition. Our algorithm achieves 91.73\% accuracy on the proposed Chandassu Score, with evaluation metrics reflecting traditional literary standards. translated_title: 面向泰卢固语文化保护的计算社会语言学：Chandassu格律模式识别的新型算法
translated_abstract: 本研究提出了一种计算社会科学方法，用于保护泰卢固语Chandassu——这一格律诗歌传统承载了数个世纪的集体文化智慧。我们开发了首个用于分析泰卢固语韵律模式的综合性数字框架，将传统社区知识与现代计算方法相融合。我们的社会计算方法包括协作构建包含4,651首标注诗歌的数据集、验证的语言模式以及基于文化认知的算法设计。该框架包含用于韵律感知分词的AksharamTokenizer、用于分类轻重音节的LaghuvuGuruvu Generator，以及用于自动模式识别的PadyaBhedam Checker。我们的算法在所提出的Chandassu Score指标上达到91.73%的准确率，评估指标反映了传统文学标准。这项工作展示了计算社会科学如何能够保护濒危的文化遗产。
tldr: 该研究开发了首个泰卢固语格律诗歌Chandassu的数字分析框架，通过构建4,651首标注诗歌的协作数据集以及韵律感知分词、音节分类和模式识别三大工具，实现了91.73%准确率的自动格律识别，为濒危的泰卢固语诗歌文化传统保护提供了计算社会科学解决方案。
en_tdlr: This research develops the first comprehensive digital framework for Telugu Chandassu metrical poetry, achieving 91.73% accuracy in automated pattern recognition through a collaboratively built dataset of 4,651 annotated poems and prosody-aware computational tools, demonstrating how computational social science can preserve endangered cultural heritage.
